description: Create a comprehensive gap year planning spreadsheet from messy raw notes. Open /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/gap_year_raw_data.xlsx containing unstructured travel information for 4 countries (Thailand, Vietnam, Portugal, Iceland). Transform the RawNotes into a structured planning tool with columns: Country, Duration (days), Daily Budget (USD), Total Cost (formula), Visa Required?, Visa Deadline, Vaccines Needed. Add a TOTAL summary row with formulas. Sort countries by visa deadline (earliest first). Save as gap_year_plan.xlsx.
